our_interpretation: Profits means positive company-wide net earnings, rather than revenue, gross margin, financing, or annualized sales.
Use calendar 2023, the latest completed financial year before publication, for the financial component. This is a period choice, not an assertion that full-year accounts had been published.
A moat means a durable advantage that protects the business against competition. Benchmark leadership or the existence of competitors alone does not establish or exclude one.
The broader target period includes the competitive position through January 27, 2024.
Marcus supplies no financial source or accounting basis, so accounting_basis remains unknown.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable company-wide financial evidence establishes no positive net earnings in the target financial period, and evidence of competitive conditions establishes an absence of durable protective advantages.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable financial evidence establishes positive net earnings, or evidence establishes a durable competitive advantage at publication.
